name: Shemariah
overview: Shemariah is a male biblical figure identified as a descendant of Bani who had married a foreign wife. Beyond this unique attribute, there is no record of his tribal affiliation or additional personal details. His mention is brief and specific to this family circumstance.
namesAndTitles: The name Shemariah means 'YHWH guards, preserves,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning common in Hebrew names that acknowledge God's protective role. This is the only recorded name for him.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Shemariah as a descendant of Bani, establishing a direct familial link. No other family relationships are documented beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Shemariah's significance lies in his inclusion among those who had married foreign wives, a matter addressed in the post-exilic community as they sought to maintain covenantal purity. His identification as a descendant of Bani situates him within the restoration period's social and religious reforms, highlighting the challenges faced by returning exiles in preserving their identity under God's covenant.
